az_cards.body:

az_cards.title: Student Media
az_cards.body: Arizona Student Media brings the campus community stories that matter while giving students hands-on experience in journalism, radio, TV, design, and business. From the student-run Arizona Daily Wildcat and KAMP Student Radio to UATV-3, these outlets showcase Wildcats making an impact.

az_cards.title: Bear Down Rundown
az_cards.body: The Bear Down Rundown is your weekly update for all main campus undergraduates during the academic year. Stay in the loop with event highlights, important reminders, and tips to make the most of your Wildcat experience.
